title: Remote mentoring
bodyMd: A company finds that remote employees who joined its mentoring programme were promoted more often than other remote employees. The programme is voluntary. An analyst notes that employees seeking promotion may be especially likely to join. She recommends comparing similar employees with different access to mentoring before attributing the promotion gap to the programme. She does not say mentoring cannot help.
